theme_architecture.archetype: Swiss High-Contrast & The Command Center Hybrid
theme_architecture.rationale: Enterprise operations spanning Dispatch, HR, PM, and Shop require intense clarity, operational precision, and strict hierarchy. A clean, high-contrast structural aesthetic ensures critical KPI visibility and mitigates cognitive load across multi-portal navigation.
theme_architecture.global_directive: Uniformity over variation. Every portal (Admin or Non-Admin) MUST adhere to a singular, predictable visual vocabulary. Prevent 'portal drift'.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-slate-900 dark:text-white
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3_widget: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
hierarchy.data_labels: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

rules: BANNED: Inter or Space Grotesk for Headings.
CRITICAL: Maintain strict tracking and tight leading for headings.
Tabular Data: Always use 'tabular-nums' class for numbers in tables, KPIs, and charts to prevent jitter.
Never center-align long blocks of text or forms. Stick to strong left alignments.

colors.base: Stark White/Off-white (bg-slate-50) for Light Mode; Deep Obsidian (bg-slate-950) for Dark Mode.
colors.primary_accent: Use stark, high-contrast structural colors (Slate, Emerald, Red, Amber) based on data state.
rules: No full-screen gradients. Function over decoration.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Neutral grays must have a slight cool tint (Slate) to feel alive.
Hover states MUST explicitly define text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

visual enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), minimal to no shadows. Focus on crispness.
visual enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. max 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-lg' (8px border-radius). Sharp, utilitarian, precise.
visual enhancers.depth: Avoid 'Glassmorphism' in these dense operational screens to prevent visual fatigue. Rely on solid colors and borders to delineate space.
visual enhancers.background_opacity: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface that has content under it.

component name.cards: Remove default drop shadows. Use 1px borders. `shadow-none border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`.
component name.tables: Dense rows. `py-2 px-3` for table cells to fit more data. Sticky headers.
component name.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (`rounded-md`). Clear distinction between primary (solid fill) and secondary (outline).
component name.navigation_sidebar: Persistent left sidebar. Must enforce uniform width, typography, and active state styles across all portals.

dashboard_density.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

grids.spacing: Generous container padding (p-6 or p-8) but tight internal widget spacing. Maximize screen real estate without feeling cluttered.

multi_portal_navigation.sidebar: Persistent, collapsible left sidebar. width: 16rem expanded, 4rem collapsed. Active states must be clearly marked with a vertical accent bar on the left and a highlighted background.
multi_portal_navigation.header: Sticky top bar with user profile, portal switcher, global search, and breadcrumbs. Solid background with a hard bottom border (border-b border-border/40). No transparent headers.

forms_and_workflows.strategy: Single-column or rigid 2-column layouts for complex data entry. Group related fields into distinct bordered panels. Always left-aligned labels.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions only. Hover states (-translate-y-[1px], border color changes), focus rings for accessibility.
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties. (e.g., 'transition-colors duration-200'). No 'transition-all'.
motion.loaders: Use skeleton screens that match the final content structure rather than generic spinning circles.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. APCA adherence. Critical data must pop.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons/links must have visible :focus-visible rings (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

media.icons: For dense dashboards and multi-portal operations, prioritize Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) for crisp readability at small sizes.
media.graphics: Keep graphics minimal. Use clear status indicators over illustrative graphics.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for dense, data-heavy enterprise portals unless required for specific logistics mapping.
3d libraries.recommendation: If spatial mapping of fleet/transportation is required, prefer Visx or React Map GL tailored for performance, rather than 3D canvases.

image urls.user_avatars: Do not use placeholders. Fall back to initial-based typographic avatars if images are not provided.
image urls.logos: Use actual brand logos. No placeholder images.

coaching_and_help.directive: Calibration & Reduction. Do not overload users with excessive onboarding text or persistent helper blocks.
implementation: Remove giant 'How to use this page' alert boxes taking up vertical space.
Use Progressive Disclosure: Move help text into '?' tooltip icons, tooltips, or slide-out help drawers.
Empty states: Provide concise 1-2 sentence instructions and a primary CTA, not a wall of text.
Inline help: Use muted, small text directly below complex inputs, strictly limited to formatting requirements.

rules: Use strong verbs for buttons (e.g., 'Save Configuration' instead of 'Submit', 'Approve Time' instead of 'OK').
Ensure consistent terminology across ALL portals (e.g., standardizing 'Personnel' vs 'Crew' based on global app context).
Eliminate jargon where a simpler term works.
Sentence case for labels and buttons. Title case for Page Titles and Major Widgets.

steps: Phase 1: Sweep ALL `.js` non-admin route files (Dispatch, Shop, Transportation, PM, HR, Safety, Forms) to ensure they share the same typography scale and layout structures.
Phase 2: Unify the Navigation/Sidebar components. Eliminate portal drift by replacing custom portal sidebars with a single, highly-configurable standard sidebar pattern.
Phase 3: Calibrate all Help and Coaching texts. Convert long paragraphs into popovers, tooltips, and concise bullet lists.
Phase 4: Perform a verbiage audit. Replace all generic button terms with direct, action-oriented verbs. Standardize naming across domains.
Phase 5: Apply visibility and spacing improvements. Enforce consistent `gap-x`, `p-x` padding conventions, and rigid table cell definitions.
Phase 6: Ensure `data-testid` is mapped to every single new or updated interactive element.
instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST sweep every non-admin route across the entire platform (Dispatch, HR, Shop, PM, Transportation, Safety, Training). Nothing is too big or too small.
You are working with `.js` files, not `.tsx`. Respect the existing React JavaScript syntax.
Standardize font classes on all major headings, strictly adhering to the defined typography and removing random occurrences.
Unify the sidebar layout across portals. Ensure the collapsible mechanism, active state styling, and spacing are 100% identical everywhere.
Calibrate coaching text: Find heavy paragraphs of help text and refactor them into Tooltips, Popovers, or succinct bullet points.
Fix Verbiage: Ensure terminology is consistent. Replace ambiguous button texts with clear, action-oriented verbs.
Add `data-testid` to all newly polished interactive elements.
DO NOT break existing API calls, functional hooks, or internal state variables while rewriting the UI layers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined typography and spacing rigorously.
Never center align the app container; do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) around major container edges to prevent a cramped feel, while keeping widget data dense internally.
Always explicitly define text colors on hover/active states.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
